definitions.explanation: arranged or connected one after another in a single line or sequence
a circuit where components are connected end to end, with current flowing through each in turn

examples.japanese: {作業|さぎょう}を{直列|ちょくれつ}で{行|おこな}う。
{直列|ちょくれつ}{処理|しょり}は{一|ひと}つずつ{順番|じゅんばん}に{実行|じっこう}する。
examples.english: Serial processing executes one at a time in order.

examples.japanese: {直列|ちょくれつ}{接続|せつぞく}だと{処理|しょり}に{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: Serial connection takes more processing time.

examples.japanese: {直列|ちょくれつ}{回路|かいろ}では{電流|でんりゅう}がどこでも{同|おな}じだ。
examples.english: In a series circuit, the current is the same everywhere.

examples.japanese: {乾電池|かんでんち}を{直列|ちょくれつ}につなぐと{電圧|でんあつ}が{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: When you connect batteries in series, the voltage increases.

examples.japanese: クリスマスライトは{直列|ちょくれつ}{接続|せつぞく}のことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Christmas lights are often connected in series.

notes:
FORMATION:
{直|ちょく} (straight, direct) + {列|れつ} (row, sequence) → straight sequence

VERB FORM:
{直列|ちょくれつ}する (to connect in series)

ANTONYM:
{並列|へいれつ} (parallel)

TECHNICAL TERMS:
- {直列|ちょくれつ}{回路|かいろ} (series circuit)
- {直列|ちょくれつ}{接続|せつぞく} (series connection)
- {直列|ちょくれつ}{処理|しょり} (serial processing)

COMPARISON:
- {直列|ちょくれつ}{回路|かいろ}: Components share current, voltage divides
- {並列|へいれつ}{回路|かいろ}: Components share voltage, current divides

NOTE:
In series circuits, if one component fails (like a light bulb), the entire circuit stops working.
